title: Roadmap: a candidate may be an agent seat, and the catalogue keeps itself current
goal: Close the two holes found when checking that the three capability claims had tasks: nothing noticed a model that appeared or was retired since the last scout, and the selection layer treated a brain as only a model - while the six agent seats are subscription-billed workers that, under marginal-cost ranking, would often be the cheapest secondaries available. Widen the candidate to a worker of either kind, keep the catalogue self-refreshing, and queue the two tasks that implement it.
